status: Post-gate development-method discovery frozen after the original all-environment feature-injection gate failed; blind HER outcomes remain unopened.
purpose: Determine whether experimental-state alignment, donor-support gating, property-family restriction, residual correction, or late fusion can convert a weak optical donor signal into a reproducible recipient benefit.
claim_guard: All results from this job are development-stage method discovery. They cannot replace the failed frozen direct-injection result or establish transfer. At most one completely specified strategy may be frozen for the still-unopened blind set.

water_methanol.rationale: Recipient measurements use a methanol-water mixture.

aqueous_small_alcohol.rationale: Broader protic-solvent sensitivity with more source coverage.

self_host_solid.rule: Solvent token exactly equals the chromophore token
self_host_solid.rationale: Recipient molecules are measured as suspended molecular solids.

development_design.independent_experimental_unit: recipient molecule with scaffold-group separation between labeled training and evaluation
development_design.computational_replicates: Draws and forest seeds quantify training-set and algorithmic variability; they are not treated as independent experimental samples.

recipient_random_forest.prediction: mean of the 20 independently seeded forests

candidate_families.direct_rank_predictions: Append training-ECDF ranks of donor predictions to the molecular fingerprint.
candidate_families.support_gated_rank_predictions: Multiply centered donor-prediction ranks by a fixed reliability score derived from state-specific source similarity and donor ensemble uncertainty, and append reliability.
candidate_families.direct_raw_predictions: Append raw donor predictions for the full property set.
candidate_families.residual_ridge: Fit a ridge model to cross-fitted target-model residuals using ranked donor predictions and uncertainties; add the correction to the target prediction.
candidate_families.late_fusion_ridge: Fit a donor-only ridge predictor and choose a convex blend with the target model from inner scaffold-group predictions; zero donor weight is allowed.
candidate_families.shuffled_rank_control: Independently shuffle donor columns within training and evaluation before appending them.

support_gate.uncertainty_factor: one minus the mean training-ECDF rank of the selected donor uncertainties

selection_rule.ranking_score: minimum mean relative RMSE gain across budgets, then primary-budget mean gain
selection_rule.abstention: If no candidate satisfies every condition, no blind strategy is released.

multiplicity_and_reporting: This is a declared method-discovery screen, not confirmatory inference. Report every candidate and control. Do not use p values from repeated computational draws as experimental evidence. The untouched blind set is the only confirmatory evaluation.

compute_target.estimated_candidate_forest_fits: approximately 0.8-1.6 million depending on state-property source admissions, across three budgets, 300 draws and 20 seeds
compute_target.intended_balam_resources: one GPU allocation with 32 CPU cores
compute_target.intended_wall_time: approximately 1-4 hours; the GPU is an allocation requirement and is not used by the tree models
